_comment: Same transfer as vision8_steer.json, plus linear probing: after steer has fit its feature-space correction, the target's zero-shot classification head is refit on a few-shot support set with the backbone frozen (linear_probe_head). The probe starts FROM the zero-shot head -- the same matrix steer's Stage 1 built its correction through via pinv(w_b) -- so its epoch-0 log line equals the plain zero-shot accuracy, and everything after that is what probing adds on top. It trains with steer's correction wrapper active, so it fits the corrected features, not the uncorrected ones.
_support_set: linear_probe_shots_per_class is not set, so the probe reuses method_params.few_shot (16/class here): probe and transport see the same support-set size. Set it explicitly to decouple them.
_head_at_eval: The probed head replaces the zero-shot head for BOTH the target_zeroshot and rebased columns, so those columns keep isolating what the correction does -- the classifier is identical on both sides.
_lr_note: linear_probe_lr must stay small relative to the head's own scale: rows are L2-normalized (entries ~1/sqrt(D)), and Adam's step is ~lr per coordinate regardless of gradient magnitude, so a large lr erases the zero-shot head in a couple of steps and the probe restarts from nothing.
